review_notes: I read all 426 lines of the target file and all its public/private declarations. I also inspected the imported library files that define the surrounding concepts (FourierRealification.lean, JSpace.lean, FourierCoordinateL2Bridge.lean, JSpaceFourierPotentialBase.lean) and the relevant Mathlib sources (Mathlib/Analysis/Distribution/SchwartzSpace/Fourier.lean, SchwartzSpace/Basic.lean `postcompCLM`, Analysis/Fourier/FourierTransform.lean, Analysis/InnerProductSpace/PiL2.lean `EuclideanSpace.single` and `EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right`, Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Dual.lean `toDual`, Analysis/Complex/Basic.lean `reCLM`), together with repository-wide greps for uses of `l2Vec3Equiv`, `l2BasisVec`, `fourier_postcompCLM`, `isWeakDivFree_congr_ae`, `realVectorL2Representative` and `realPartVectorL2Representative`. Candidates considered and rejected under this rubric: `l2Vec3Equiv` (lines 32–36) is the named 3-dimensional specialisation of Mathlib's `PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv`, not an independent concept; `l2BasisVec` (lines 43–46) is `PiLp.single`/`EuclideanSpace.single` at value 1, and its private norm/inner lemmas are proof helpers rather than substantive API; `gradientOfCovector(Linear)` is a bundled coordinate-extraction map not supplied by Mathlib's Riesz `toDual` (whose codomain is a real dual/StrongDual rather than a real-linear map into ℂ), and it is a composition of existing Mathlib maps; `fourier_postcompCLM` has no Mathlib counterpart (Mathlib has only `fourier_evalCLM_eq`, `fourier_fderivCLM_eq`, and `fourierIntegral_continuousLinearMap_apply` for maps into `F →L E`, not postcomposition of a CLM); the `weakTest*` and `real*Representative` definitions have no Mathlib analogue. The remaining candidates are theorems (`isWeakDivFree_congr_ae`, `realPartVectorL2Representative_eq_ae`, etc.), and standalone theorem duplication is explicitly excluded. I noted two library-internal duplications that are outside the stated Mathlib-duplication rubric and therefore not reported: `CKN.Leray.l2Vec3Equiv` is byte-identical to `CKN.l2Vec3Equiv` in JSpaceFourierPotentialBase.lean lines 157–160, `CKN.Leray.l2BasisVec` mirrors `CKN.l2BasisVec3` there, and `isWeakDivFree_congr_ae` is re-proved as `regR12_isWeakDivFreeL2_congr` in RegularisedR12FinalR1.lean lines 31–38. I could not compile any hypothetical replacement; the assessment is based on source reading and grep evidence.
